rules: Title gate: an auto-fetched item only becomes a signal if a field keyword appears in its title (word-boundary match), the same lesson as the water board.
Privacy is deliberately weighted above its natural volume so AI news does not flood the board and drift the brand.
Every signal must link to its original source. No source link, no signal.
No price predictions, no buy or sell calls, no guaranteed-return language. The board feeds content, not financial advice.
Dedupe by normalised URL plus title together, because distinct stories legitimately share one source report URL. Manual (Muse sweep) entries are never overwritten by the auto updater.
Freshness matters: auto signals older than 14 days drop off the board. Manual signals stay until a sweep retires them.
Scams, unverified giveaway accounts and too-good-to-be-true airdrops are rejected, not listed as warnings, unless a warning itself is the content.
